answeredQuestions.product-name: Zava Cold Chain Monitor — production readiness (derived directly from the approved BRD, no live user present)
answeredQuestions.core-problem: Five evidence-backed trust-by-familiarity gaps (alarm triage/escalation, command approval-vs-enforcement, assistant steering with no accountable owner, vacant ownership, unproven scale assumption) must become trust-by-design controls before the board's 400-store, 12-month commitment, per BRD-2026-COLDCHAIN-001.
answeredQuestions.solution-approach: Decompose BG-001-BG-006 into 19 product-level FRs across five domains (alarm/escalation, command/identity, assistant, ownership, scale-gating), sequence delivery with exactly one P0 slice (FR-001, prototyped and measured this session), and hand off identity/vendor and RAI-depth work to Security Planner and RAI Planner respectively.
answeredQuestions.product-type: Production-readiness hardening of an existing prototype application (not a new product); scope bounded to BRD-2026-COLDCHAIN-001's six business goals.
answeredQuestions.target-users: Night store manager / regional night cover, refrigeration technician, Regional IT, vendor support, food-safety officer, executive sponsor / Investment Board (carried from BRD Stakeholders and Stage 1 Design Thinking personas).

referencesProcessed.keyFindings: ALM-07 exempts any case.mode == 'defrost' from alarms regardless of duration; case.defrost_until is None for indefinite defrosts and auto-reverts mode to normal when set. Direct physics measurement: 20-min defrost peaks at -13.0C (no breach), 25-min at -11.3C (breach), 40-min at -6.5C (breach) against the -12.0C freezer limit.

tests/test_business.py already contains a helper _alarm_in_any_mode documented as 'a stand-in for change 1' that fully removes the ALM-07 exemption; measured directly in a disposable prototype to false-page the 40-minute approved vendor maintenance defrost (peak -6.5C). A targeted prototype fix (exempt only while case.defrost_until is not None) was applied to a discarded /tmp copy of the repository, never committed: python -m unittest showed 7 failures + 1 error in tests that encode the undetected-case gap as expected behavior (test_silent_freezers_are_found_by_staff_not_alarms, test_an_earlier_door_alarm_does_not_count_for_a_later_silent_defrost, test_detecting_sooner_costs_less, test_leaderboard_ranks_against_the_baseline_for_the_same_seed, test_the_alarms_that_fire_are_not_for_the_freezers_that_fail, test_products_at_risk_are_grouped, test_mass_defrost_predicts_shoppers_in_every_store, test_pulling_stock_moves_shoppers_to_empty_shelves); python -m zava_cold_chain gauntlet --seed 2026 showed total_eur 768013 -> 454371.
